name: InterContinental Jordan
insider_take: This luxury landmark sits majestically on the highest of Amman's seven hills, offering sweeping views of the ancient city where Roman ruins meet modern sophistication.
whats_special: Built on Jebel Amman, the hotel's elevated position provides panoramic vistas of the sprawling capital. The property features Jordan's largest ballroom and houses an impressive collection of local art and artifacts. Its strategic location puts you within walking distance of the vibrant Rainbow Street and the historic downtown souks.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing west for stunning sunset views over the city's white limestone buildings and catch glimpses of the Roman Amphitheater illuminated at night.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop terrace offers unmatched city views, while the nearby Citadel (Jabal al-Qal'a) showcases 7,000 years of history just minutes away. Explore the King Hussein Mosque and traditional gold souks within a short stroll from your luxury base.
pros: Prime location in Amman's city center with easy access to attractions
Outstanding Middle Eastern cuisine and dining options
Professional business center and meeting facilities
cons: Urban setting may lack resort-style ambiance
